fields.title: Binary Search
fields.description:
Given an array of integers nums which is sorted in ascending order, and an integer target, write a function to search target in nums. If target exists, then return its index. Otherwise, return -1.

You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime complexity.

fields.title: Find Peak Element
fields.description:
A peak element is an element that is strictly greater than its neighbors.

Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, find a peak element, and return its index. If the array contains multiple peaks, return the index to any of the peaks.

You may imagine that nums[-1] = nums[n] = -Γê₧. In other words, an element is always considered to be strictly greater than a neighbor that is outside the array.
fields.constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 1000
-2^31 <= nums[i] <= 2^31 - 1
nums[i] != nums[i + 1] for all valid i.

fields.title: Two Sum
fields.description:
Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

You can return the answer in any order.

fields.title: Frog Jump
fields.description:
A frog is crossing a river. The river is divided into some number of units, and at each unit, there may or may not exist a stone. The frog can jump on a stone, but it must not jump into the water.

Given a list of stones positions (in units) in sorted ascending order, determine if the frog can cross the river by landing on the last stone. Initially, the frog is on the first stone and assumes the first jump must be 1 unit.

If the frog's last jump was k units, its next jump must be either k - 1, k, or k + 1 units. The frog can only jump in the forward direction.
fields.constraints:
2 <= stones.length <= 2000
0 <= stones[i] <= 2^31 - 1
stones[0] == 0
stones is sorted in a strictly increasing order.

fields.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
fields.description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without duplicate characters.
fields.constraints:
0 <= s.length <= 5 * 10^4
s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
